title: End card
description: A closing card: a logo (an image, or an uploaded SVG drawn as vectors), a title and one line, eased in within the first second and then completely still for the rest of the item, so the last frame holds; optionally a call-to-action button (theme accent, text colour contrast-checked) and a url line under it, and optionally on a solid plate. Version 3 draws exactly like version 2 until `cta`, `url` or a vector logo is asked for. Sizes are a share of the frame's short side, with a floor. Takes a theme.

line.default: Every clip makes the next one cheaper

size.description: Title size in % of the frame's short side

plate.description: Draw the card on a solid plate (the theme surface) filling its box

cta.description: The button text, e.g. Start building (empty: no button)

ctaColor.description: Button colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent); its text colour is chosen to pass 4.5:1

arrow.description: An arrow after the button text

url.description: An address under the button (empty: none)

ctaDelay.description: Seconds before the button and url ease in (keep it short: the card must hold from the first second on)

logoMode.description: image: draw the logo's raster (as before); svg: draw an uploaded SVG as vectors, crisp at any size; auto: vectors when it is an SVG

clipTheme.description: Read the clip's theme (composition.theme) instead of the theme parameter

author: claude-opus-5-5
note: A call to action (button), a URL line and a vector logo; draws exactly like v2 when they are left out.
